data.message: I maintain my 18-ton commitment. Your future-stock concern is valid. If the nine stated 18s and sixteen 10s hold, 178 remain; next stock is 500 (75%) or 356 (25%). Intentions aren't binding; future catches must adjust. Each 10-ton fisher: would you opt for 18 even if others stay at 10? Please state your exact choice and any conditions.
